ce_bugs.text: Template group_member.hbs resolves 'automatic' against the member context instead of the group, so the remove link renders for members of automatic groups and removal always fails with 422
groups_controller members endpoint has no ceiling on limit param, allowing unbounded member list dumping and member enumeration (regression from previous 200 cap)
Unbounded input in add_members: no cap on number of usernames, allowing a request to issue thousands of queries/inserts
visible parsed with strict string comparison (params[:visible] == 'true') — JSON boolean true silently becomes false, making the group private
add_members crashes with 500 (NoMethodError on split) if usernames is sent as a JSON array instead of a comma-separated string
groups_controller.rb add_members does not trim whitespace from usernames and silently skips unknown usernames with no feedback
remove_member automatic-group test uses xhr :put but the route is DELETE-only, so it tests routing failure rather than the can_not_modify_automatic guard; should be xhr :delete
add_members splits usernames without strip/reject(&:blank?), so whitespace-padded usernames fail User.find_by_username silently and are untested
`usernames.split(",")` doesn't trim whitespace, so "bob, alice" fails to match "alice" (app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:73-83)
Rapid next/previous clicks race: offset is set optimistically and each request overwrites `members` on arrival (admin-group.js.es6)
`addMembers` input is never cleared after adding, so clicking Add again re-adds the same usernames (admin-group.js.es6:60-64)
create action drops client-sent alias_level (and other attributes), so new groups get default alias level despite admin's choice
totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, producing an extra empty page for exact multiples; should be Math.ceil(user_count / limit)

Pagination race: offset set optimistically before findMembers(); concurrent AJAX responses can render out of order, leaving currentPage inconsistent with the member list; no re-entrancy guard on pager links
update unconditionally sets group.visible = params[:visible] == "true", silently making visible groups invisible when the param is absent in partial updates

usernames param not handled robustly server-side: Array input makes .split(",") raise NoMethodError (500), and entries are not stripped/validated so whitespace or trailing commas silently fail to match users
removeMember/addMembers reload with stale offset, which can leave a blank member list and currentPage > totalPages after removing members
Public groups#members endpoint has no cap on limit, allowing callers to pull entire member lists plus total count, aiding enumeration

mrv_findings.text: spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb uses xhr :put for remove_member but the route is delete, causing routing error instead of asserted 422; spec cannot pass as written
admin-group.js.es6 totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, off-by-one when member count is exact multiple of limit; should be Math.ceil, breaking pagination guard

group.js create sets id from resp.basic_group.id but server renders serialized group at top level without basic_group wrapper, so id never set and member-management UI doesn't render for freshly created group
GroupsController#create drops alias_level: client sends alias_level and UI shows combo-box for new groups, but create only assigns name and visible, so alias level is silently not persisted

GroupsController#add_members silently succeeds for nonexistent usernames: unknown names are skipped and success_json rendered, and the client input isn't cleared, so admins believe users were added when they weren't
GroupsController#remove_member reports success when removing a non-member: group.users.delete on a non-member id is a no-op and user_id is never validated, with no acceptance criterion or test
GroupsController#remove_member calls group.save after a HABTM delete, which is pointless since membership is already persisted, making the render_json_error branch unreachable

admin-group.js.es6 removeMember/next/previous/routes have no error path or loading state: setupController calls model.findMembers() without returning the promise or handling rejection, so AJAX failure renders an empty member list indistinguishable from a legitimately empty group

Pagination edge case: after removeMember/addMembers, user_count shrinks but offset is kept, so admins on the last page see an empty members page since the server never clamps offset to total and the client clamps against pre-request values
GroupsController#members paginated response shape (members + meta: {total, limit, offset}) has zero test coverage despite the client depending on it and the endpoint being rewritten

Public group-members page sets members asynchronously but the template binds against the model (group), which has no members until AJAX resolves, and the route no longer waits, so a slow/failed request renders a permanently empty members table with no loading or failure criterion
Public group members page has no pagination while backend hard-limits to 50 members, so groups with >50 members silently show only first 50 to regular users
Removal of get "users" route from admin groups collection breaks existing consumers of /admin/groups/:id/users with no replacement or mention in PR intent
Whitespace-only reformatting in admin-group-selector.hbs and user-selector-autocomplete.raw.hbs not traceable to membership-handling intent
Extracted .form-horizontal label/input-width rules in admin_base.scss now scoped to .groups and .badges, causing scope drift and potential unintended visual changes on badges admin page
groups_controller_spec remove_member test sends PUT which routes to add_members, so the remove_member automatic-group guard is never actually tested and regressions would go undetected
admin-group.js.es6 addMembers has TODO to clear input and doesn't handle promise rejection, leaving stale usernames on failed add
group.hbs pagination math totalPages = floor(user_count/limit) + 1 produces an empty trailing page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit
remove_member uses group.users.delete(user_id), bypassing model maintenance path, so cached user_count drifts from truth after removals (P1, confidence 75)
Two sources of truth for member counts: meta.total uses live group.users.count while admin index uses stale user_count column, causing disagreement for groups with removed members (P1, confidence 75)

Unversioned breaking API change in create/update: request shape silently changed from nested group[name]/group[usernames]/group[visible] to flat top-level params, breaking existing API consumers (P1, confidence 100)
PATCH changes-based incremental add/delete endpoint deleted outright with no deprecation or replacement for non-UI callers of PATCH /admin/groups/:id (P1, confidence 75)
Spec test for remove_member issues a PUT, which routes to add_members in production routing; spec bypasses routing so DELETE member path and its automatic-group guard are untested (P2, confidence 75)
findMembers pagination totalPages = floor(user_count/limit)+1 is off-by-one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, rendering an empty member page (P3, confidence 75)
add_members silently drops nonexistent usernames and returns success_json even when zero requested users existed, making typo'd usernames silently swallowed (P2, confidence 75)

remove_member mutates join table via group.users.delete before gating on group.save with no transaction, so a validation failure returns an error over already-committed state change (P2, confidence 75)
PATCH-based incremental membership API (changes: {add, delete}) in admin/groups_controller.rb removed entirely with no deprecation path, breaking external consumers of PATCH /admin/groups/:id

createWithUsernames / group creation with initial members removed; group creation no longer accepts usernames, forcing a two-step create-then-add flow and regressing the seed-members-at-creation feature
remove_member uses group.users.delete(user_id), bypassing callbacks of group.remove(user) so groups.user_count is not decremented and becomes stale
Spec for remove_member uses xhr :put but the route is delete, so the request routes to add_members and the automatic-group guard in remove_member is untested

groups_controller#members now unconditionally paginates all groups (including automatic ones) at 50, replacing prior behavior showing up to 200 members, with no pagination UI on the public group/members template

Unbounded client-controlled `limit` on group membership enumeration in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb allows mass-enumeration/scraping of full member lists (membership-privacy regression); clamp limit to a max (e.g. 200)
Unvalidated `offset` parameter allows negative values passed to .offset(), producing a 500 DB error; clamp offset to >= 0
Admin groups add_members does not normalize usernames before lookup (raw split of usernames string), so entries with whitespace silently fail to match
Non-existent usernames in add_members fail silently with a 200 response, resulting in silent partial success while the client reports success

spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:104-107 uses xhr :put for remove_member but the route maps only DELETE, so the test exercises groups#add_members instead and never executes remove_member's automatic-group guard

remove_member uses group.users.delete(user_id) which bypasses the user_count counter cache, leaving group.user_count stale and breaking admin UI count and members-list pagination, and the happy-path test never asserts user_count

The new client-side pagination model (findMembers, next/previous, totalPages, etc.) has no JS test coverage; totalPages = floor(user_count/limit)+1 yields 3 pages for exactly 100 users and next clamps offset to user_count causing an empty final page fetch
The rewritten update action has no test for the non-automatic group update path (name rename, alias_level, visible); only the automatic-group name-ignore branch is covered

GroupsController#update silently ignores the legacy `group: { usernames: ... }` parameter, so old cached clients' membership changes are dropped with a 200 response and no error (expand+contract violation)
GroupsController#create reads top-level params[:name]/params[:visible] while old clients POST nested `group: { name, usernames }`, causing save failures or wrong payloads during the deploy window
GroupsController#create removes ability to seed members at creation with no migration path, since old clients cannot add members (add_members requires an existing id)
remove_member uses group.users.delete(user_id), bypassing Group#remove and skipping bookkeeping like user_count counter maintenance and membership side effects
Stale denormalized user_count can cause blank or paged-off-end member lists in the new paginated UI and findMembers offset math

Removal of the old GET 'users' admin route in the same commit that switches the client to members.json leaves no dual-availability window; cached admin JS or external consumers hitting /admin/groups/:id/users get a 404 mid-rollout
